title: 電動キックスクーター
description: バッテリーデッキ、前後のタイヤ、ハブモーター、折りたたみ部、ブレーキレバーとケーブル、泥よけ、ライト、反射板、展開したスタンドを備えた無銘の電動キックスクーター。静止した配置用小道具で、走行機能・安全性・機構の作動は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: Unbranded electric kick scooter with battery deck, profiled tires, rear hub-motor cover, folding collar, connected brake cable and lever, mudguards, lamps, reflectors and deployed kickstand. Static placement prop; not rigged and not validated for riding, safety or mechanical operation. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Automatically unwrapped UV0 for each named static assembly; islands can overlap between assemblies. Not a packed unique lightmap or shared trim atlas. Solid-color PBR materials, no image textures. STL carries geometry only, without colors or UVs.

provenance.rights: Original geometry and material design created for Xenoah Meshcopia under the owner request for CC-BY-4.0 publication. No third-party meshes, scans, brands, logos or font files.
provenance.alternateFormat: Binary STL derived from the exact reimported GLB, meters and Y-up. Visual prop only, not manufacturing or print validated.
provenance.assemblyMethod: Original closed mesh components with bevels and curved tubes, converted and joined into named static assemblies before export. No external models or texture images; no decimation.

selectors: Connected brake cable and wire guides
Front and rear mudguards with lamps
usages.context: Original static urban prop created for the Meshcopia library. Selectors name the generator asset ID and the exact exported mesh assemblies. No external deployment or reuse claimed.
